name: verifyUser

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the target user

parameters.name: custom_description
parameters.description: Custom description for the verification; 0-70 characters. Must be empty if the organization isn't allowed to provide a custom verification description.

parameters.name: custom_description_parse_mode
parameters.description: Mode for parsing entities in the custom description. See formatting options for more details. Only “text_link” entities are supported.

parameters.name: custom_description_entities
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the custom description, which can be specified instead of custom_description_parse_mode. Only “text_link” entities are supported.

description: Verifies a user on behalf of the organization which is represented by the bot. Returns True on success.
